svg.text: Signal layer: one action. Mission layer: compact work. Depth appears only after entry.

g.text: Find the published record or resource you need
Search identifiers, titles, topics, sources, and practitioner resources.
Official records identify their publisher and source.
No rotating slogan. No RMF default. Search is visible without scrolling.
Sorted by identifier/title match, then text relevance
Exact unique identifiers may open directly; ambiguous text always remains in Search.
Choose a declared scope. Path, Map, and List cover the same records.
Unknown ancestry is stated. Baselines and mappings never become parents.
Official frameworks, catalogs, requirements, mappings, and published datasets.
Publisher is a filter. Useful type grouping is the default. Counts always reconcile.
No separate descriptive title is published for this subcategory.
Incidents are declared when adverse events meet
CSF 2.0 › Detect › Adverse Event Analysis › DE.AE-08
Official identity first. Product navigation and raw metadata disclose later.
Only mappings from the selected cited source appear.
A mapping does not determine equivalent coverage or applicability.
Mode selection immediately reveals inputs; no five-card dead-end chooser.
Work from a task, document, or resource
Why included: supports OSCAL validation · verify fit independently
Resources remains under Build, but is a first-screen equal lane and Home entrance.
Product-authored material is labeled and never presented as publisher guidance.
Compare two frameworks using a published mapping
Steps · source basis · limitations · next action
No novice/beginner labels. Empty Learn is not globally exposed.
Sources used for records, official text, and published relationships.
Build → Resources contains tools, templates, training, and communities.
Compact register first. Resources boundary is one sentence, not a promo panel.
